mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points in three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 2%) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized < 2%) indicates sustainable economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through robust corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: Joint signal produces negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.25% in three months), reduced liquidity and higher cost of capital produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening cycles are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 105.0) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate profit margin improvements.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is not followed by positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or correlation with returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 1000.0 units in three months signals weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced construction sector activity.
failure_condition: HOUST decline is not followed by negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in three months) and declining unemployment (UNRATE falls > 0.2pp) indicate labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through increased consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or return difference from baseline is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2% and UNRATE < 5.0%), strong economic fundamentals drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days before potential cyclical reversal.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion instances, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
